0.reason: Non-blocking: the centroid series and the 1e-10 limit share the neutral grey but differ in dash and legend entry; the series is the negative control, set against the subject, so grey is its correct role.

findings.summary: Collocated data series and the tolerance threshold share one colour: COLLOCATED is #929292 (line 35) and LIMIT is #929292 (line 36), so the oscillating centroid-sampled curve and the dotted 1e-10 tolerance rule are drawn in the same grey. The legend and the dash pattern still separate them, and the reader can decode both, but a colour that names a measured series in this figure also names a threshold, which is the one place the figure's colour vocabulary is ambiguous. A distinct neutral for the rule, or the near-black dashed style the repository uses for design and reference lines, would remove the ambiguity.

docs/figures/iron-core-magnetisation/icm.contrast: pass - axis, tick and legend text renders at #0b0b0b, about 19:1 on white. The green series is #2e8b57 and the grey series and tolerance rule are #929292, measured at exactly 146 on white, 3.1:1, which meets the mark floor. No text sits on a coloured ground.
docs/figures/iron-core-magnetisation/icm.data_ink: pass - the plotted ink is three polylines, five round Newton markers, one hollow convergence marker and one dotted tolerance rule. No gridline, no fill and no shaded band compete with them.
docs/figures/iron-core-magnetisation/icm.decoration: pass - no gradient, no background fill and no decorative styling. Top and right spines are absent, leaving only the left and bottom axes that carry scales.
docs/figures/iron-core-magnetisation/icm.label_collision: pass - the three-column figure legend sits in clear white space across the top, its first row clear of the second, and the axes top is well below it. Non-white content occupies x 16-1322 and y 28-685 of the 1400x721 canvas, so no text is clipped at any edge, and no tick label, axis label or legend entry touches another or the data.
docs/figures/iron-core-magnetisation/icm.legibility: pass - one log-y panel on a 1400x721 canvas: the Newton correction history falls from 1e0 to about 5.8e-14 in four marked corrections, the green Galerkin Picard curve falls geometrically to 7.8e-11 at iteration 12 where a hollow green circle marks its end, and the grey centroid-sampled Picard curve oscillates between roughly 4e-4 and 2e-3 across 50 iterations. Ticks are labelled 10^0 down to 10^-14 and 0 to 50 every ten, both axes name their quantity, and the residual axis states its normalisation '||F(M)|| / max(||M||, ||B||/mu0)'. The reader can read the comparison at a glance.
docs/figures/iron-core-magnetisation/icm.table_form: pass - three residual trajectories against iteration, whose crossing of a tolerance and geometric versus oscillating decay are properties of the curve shape; a table of iteration counts and final residuals would not show the oscillation the figure exists to show.
